# This is the CMakeCache file. For build comments, see the end of this file.
# The format is:
# KEY:TYPE=VALUE
# where TYPE may be BOOL, PATH, FILEPATH, STRING, INTERNAL, STATIC, UNINITIALIZED

//Value of the CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME variable.
CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME:STATIC=leveldb

//Value of the CMAKE_PROJECT_VERSION variable.
CMAKE_PROJECT_VERSION:STATIC=1.23.0

//Value of the CMAKE_PROJECT_VERSION variable.
CMAKE_PROJECT_VERSION_MAJOR:STATIC=1

//Value of the CMAKE_PROJECT_VERSION variable.
CMAKE_PROJECT_VERSION_MINOR:STATIC=23

//Value of the CMAKE_PROJECT_VERSION variable.
CMAKE_PROJECT_VERSION_PATCH:STATIC=0

//Value of the CMAKE_PROJECT_VERSION variable.
CMAKE_PROJECT_VERSION_TWEAK:STATIC=

//Path to CMake source directory.
CMAKE_HOME_DIRECTORY:INTERNAL=/home/build/leveldb

///////////////////////////
// leveldb_SOURCE_DIR
leveldb_SOURCE_DIR:STATIC=/home/build/leveldb

///////////////////////////
// leveldb_BINARY_DIR
leveldb_BINARY_DIR:STATIC=/home/build/leveldb/build

///////////////////////////
// leveldb_IS_TOP_LEVEL
leveldb_IS_TOP_LEVEL:STATIC=ON

//Details about finding Threads.
FIND_PACKAGE_MESSAGE_DETAILS_Threads:INTERNAL=[TRUE][v()]

//CPack package vendor.
CPACK_PACKAGE_VENDOR:INTERNAL=Google
